phrases.text: Your QR code came from a board game.
In 1994, engineer Masahiro Hara had a problem at a car parts factory.
Barcodes held too little, so workers scanned box after box.
Playing Go at lunch, he saw it: black and white stones on a grid can hold information.
Three corner squares let a scanner read it from any angle.
And his company let everyone use it free.
When did you last scan one? Comment below, and subscribe for more.
